title: The Second Orchard
author: Quentin Iversen
blurb: Oscar Villalobos, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
